# MAX_HOLD_STUDY 2026-11-21 — full tables (auto-generated by scripts/MAX_HOLD_STUDY_2026-11-21_report.py)

Units: % of notional per fill at ONE size, net of fees, slip and real funding. Δ = cap − today per fill (all fills; untouched fills Δ = 0, `untouched_max` must read 0). CI = day-block bootstrap 95 % (entry day clusters, 4,000 draws). $ = Σ % × X × $10,000 (X = 0.61 EXH / DIST / FB, 0.305 HT / WILLY). DCR = one-size daily compound over every calendar day of the block, %/day. fund_eff = Δ − Δ price-only (the part of Δ due to funding). d_s02 / d_s30 = Δ with the time-exit slip at 0.02 / 0.30 %. Change classes: 'n · Σ Δ pts'. Backtest rows whose funding months are missing for the longest cap are dropped (EXH 80, DIST 2, FB 6).
